Native plants—like our Illinois-native trees, shrubs, and perennials—are among the highest-quality and most dependable choices for long-term outdoor success.
Because they have adapted locally over time to our specific climate, regional soils, and severe weather changes, they establish stronger root systems, handle summer heat and winter cold better, and require fewer fertilizers or pesticides than non-native varieties. Many of our native trees and shrubs are also grown locally on our 183-acre farm in Wisconsin to ensure exceptional quality and hardiness.
